notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.notes: [p][i]Typingvania[/i] has received a very warm welcome since its release. Thank you! Please leave a review if you haven't — it really helps.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's what changed in [b]update v1.2[/b]:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where words containing the focus character would not be scheduled, making it impossible to progress[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b] UI language[/p][/*][*][p]Added “English (no tone marks)” input option to 《红楼梦》 (Simplified Chinese) to better match native typing[/p][/*][/list]
